physicalNotes: Radius 1.37 Jupiter radii from Clark et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..207C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..207C/abstract): 97,944 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 2.8 Jupiter masses (Clark et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023AJ....165..207C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..207C/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
